text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim that driverless cars \"are not a good investment\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a definite position early and keeps returning to it."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on \"not truly driverless\" and \"entertainment and the driver's enjoyment\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its argument in separate, focused body paragraphs rather than moving in a single loose stream."},{"evidence":"quotes the article and explains why alerting the driver creates \"unneeded complications\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay goes beyond summary by connecting evidence to an argument about why the feature is a drawback."},{"evidence":"\"Overall, driverless cars would not benefit our lives enough to invest a lot in this field\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a clear wrap-up that restates the position and briefly synthesizes the main reasons."},{"evidence":"mentions cost, safety, and extra technology as drawbacks","quality":"development","description":"The essay supports its stance with multiple distinct points instead of relying on a single repeated claim."}]}
